## Purpose

Describe the correction or improvement and the affected files.

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Python files compile successfully.
- [ ] JSON and citation metadata validate.
- [ ] Derived-output changes identify their inputs and generating scripts.
- [ ] Immutable Zenodo version 1.0 artifacts were not silently replaced.
- [ ] No licensed data, credentials, private paths, or vendor material are included.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated where needed.

## Scope

State whether this changes code, results, prose, metadata, or licensing.
